title: Intellicheck Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results | Intellicheck
summary: Intellicheck reports Q3 2026 results: net income of $0.5M, Adjusted EBITDA of $0.9M, and $13.2M in cash with no debt, marking a fifth straight profitable quarter.
body_markdown:
*Net Income Rises to $0.5 Million*


*Adjusted EBITDA Increases to $0.9 Million*


*Cash Balance Grows to $13.2 Million, Highest Level Since the End of 2021, with No Debt*


‍


MELVILLE, NEW YORK – November 12, 2026 – Intellicheck, Inc. (Nasdaq: IDN) (“Intellicheck” or the “Company”), an industry-leading identity company delivering proprietary on-demand digital and physical identification validation solutions, today reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.


‍


“We delivered our fifth consecutive quarter of profitability and sixth consecutive quarter of positive Adjusted EBITDA in Q3 2026, with both net income and Adjusted EBITDA up year-over-year, demonstrating the strength and durability of our business model,” said Bryan Lewis, President and Chief Executive Officer of Intellicheck. “We are building larger customer relationships, with almost every customer expanding their commercial relationship with us. We are also extending our reach through partners, including a channel partner deployment with one of the world’s largest investment management companies that brings our technology into wealth management for the first time, along with new partnerships in automotive credit and freight logistics. With synthetic identity and deepfake-driven fraud continuing to rise, our differentiated technology is now more valuable than ever.”


‍


**Business Highlights**


- Revenue was $5.7 million in the third quarter, down 5% year-over-year and 3% sequentially. SaaS revenue comprised substantially all of total revenue.
- Net income was $0.5 million in the third quarter, increasing $0.2 million year-over-year, marking the Company’s fifth consecutive quarter of profitability.
- Adjusted EBITDA, a non-GAAP metric, was $0.9 million in the third quarter, increasing $0.3 million year-over-year and marking the Company’s sixth consecutive positive quarter.
- Banking and lending continues to be the Company’s largest growing vertical in terms of total revenue as it continues to gain traction.
- Momentum continued across emerging and adjacent verticals including cargo and freight, foreign auto manufacturers and their supplier networks, stadium and venue concessions, age-related and background-check verticals, and automotive dealer scanning volumes.


‍


**Financial and Balance Sheet Highlights**


- Gross margin was 91% in both the 2026 and 2025 third quarters.
- Operating expenses were $4.9 million in the third quarter, compared to $5.2 million in the year-ago period.
- Income from operations was $0.4 million and net income was $0.5 million, up from $0.2 million and $0.3 million, respectively, in the year-ago period.
- Adjusted EBITDA was $0.9 million in the third quarter, marking the Company’s sixth consecutive positive quarter. Adjusted EBITDA was $0.6 million in the third quarter of 2025.
- The Company ended the quarter with $13.2 million in cash and no debt. Cash from operations for the first nine months of 2026 was $3.3 million.


‍


“We remain profitable and cash from operations came in ahead of what we anticipated last quarter,” said Adam Sragovicz, Chief Financial Officer of Intellicheck. “Cash rose $1.3 million in the quarter to $13.2 million, our highest quarter-end level since the end of 2021, and we have no debt. We will continue to hold a tight line on costs while funding the engineering and go-to-market investment behind Desktop and our channel partnerships. Our balance sheet gives us the flexibility to execute on our growth initiatives.”


‍

**About Intellicheck**


Intellicheck (Nasdaq: IDN), the industry leader in identity verification management, prevents the use of unauthorized IDs to stop identity-based fraud. Intellicheck is the only SaaS-based validation and proofing service that uses a unique and proprietary analysis of DMV-issued IDs to create trusted, real-time customer identity verification experiences across a wide variety of sectors, both in-person and digitally. Intellicheck is processing identity transactions for almost half the adult population in the United States and Canada annually with state-of-the-art technology solutions that are providing a seamless, invisible ID verification experience while delivering 99.975% decisioning in under a second when a customer is using our tools to capture the document. For more information on Intellicheck, visit us on the[web](https://www.intellicheck.com/) and follow us on[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/intellicheck-inc-) ,[X](https://twitter.com/IDNIntellicheck) ,[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/intellicheckidn/) , and[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@IntellicheckIDN) .
